This sounds like it may involve sexual harassment. I can't assess what happened or take a complaint, but you can speak to the Internal Committee in confidence. Internal Committee (POSH): ic@nexora.example. You can also talk to the Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): 1800-000-0000 (extension 9), 24x7, confidential. If you are in immediate danger, call 112.

What the POSH Policy says about the process:
You can first speak confidentially to your HR Business Partner for guidance, as suggested in the handbook scenario G.3. If you decide to file a formal complaint, you may submit it in writing to the Internal Committee within three months of the incident (or three months from the last incident in a series) and the Committee can extend this period by up to three months for valid reasons [S1][S7][S8]. The complaint can be made via email, sealed envelope, or the prescribed Annexure A form, and must include details of the incidents, dates, places, witnesses and any supporting documents [S8]. If you are unable to write the complaint yourself, a designated person such as a relative, friend or co‑worker may do so on your behalf with your consent [S8]. Any manager or employee who receives a disclosure must forward it to the Internal Committee within one Working Day and keep it confidential [S8].
